sentences.text: Page No.# 2/3 13.06.2024 Heard Mr. S. H. Sikdar, learned counsel appearing for the accused petitioner as well as Mr. R. J. Baruah, learned Addl. P.P., Assam appearing for the State respondent.

By filing this petition under Section 439 Cr.P.C., the accused-petitioner, namely, Maniru Zaman @
Moniru Jaman, has prayed for grant of bail in connection with Hatigaon P.S. Case No.46/2024 under Sections 376 IPC R/W Section 4 of POCSO Act.
It is submitted by the learned counsel for the petitioner that the accused petitioner has completed the mandatory period of 90 days in judicial custody and charge-sheet has not yet been submitted.
Leaned counsel for the petitioner has prayed for default bail.
Mr. R. J. Baruah, learned Additional Public Prosecutor has submitted that investigation is still pending as charge-sheet has not yet been submitted.
However, he has made objection in granting bail to the petitioner.

In view of the submission of learned counsel for both the parties and considering the length of detention, this Court is of the view that further custodial interrogation of the accused-petitioner is not necessary in the interest of investigation of the case.

Accordingly, the petitioner, named above, shall be released on bail, on furnishing bail bond of Rs.50,000/- with two suitable sureties of the like amount, to the satisfaction of learned Special Judge, Kamrup(M), Guwahati.
In terms of the above, this bail application stands disposed of.
